question: Should any of the showdown boards' house rules be lifted? The owner (2026-11-27): "Register a separate prospective test for removing the $11,000 captain salary restriction. Also investigate defense/kicker captain eligibility, opposing defense restrictions and the other artificial roster gates independently and jointly. Distinguish optimal-lineup eligibility from actual optimizer performance. Evaluate uncertainty across independent slates, not just simulated worlds."

primary_definitions.H1: the $11,000 captain floor (nfl_dfs._SD_MIN_CPT_SALARY, binding when three such captains exist) lifted
primary_definitions.H2: kickers and defenses may captain, exempt from the salary floor (the only way one can where it binds); every other captain keeps the floor
primary_definitions.H3: a defense may sit beside the opposing team's captain
primary_definitions.H5: more than one tight end a team allowed
primary_definitions.H6: the two-punt cap and the punt-role rule (a $2,000-or-under player must be RB1-2, WR1-3 or TE1) lifted

secondary_definition: every house rule lifted jointly (the depth gate kept): reported, decides nothing
statistic: per slate s, d_s = P(any of the variant's 20 chosen entries in the top 1%) minus the same for conservative, both portfolios chosen by the variant's own ranking on worlds 0-29,999 and scored on the independent worlds 30,000-59,999 against the conservative board's field (research/dfs_eligibility_compare.py, unchanged). This is the optimizer's performance; the share of worlds whose hindsight-optimal lineup a rule removes (optimal-lineup eligibility) is reported beside it and never decides.
uncertainty: one number per slate; D = mean d_s, SE = sd(d_s)/sqrt(n) over SLATES (clustered: the within-slate paired SE over worlds is never used); t = D/SE, one-sided p from Student's t with n - 1 degrees of freedom.
multiplicity: Holm's step-down across the six primaries at a family-wise one-sided 5% (alpha_familywise_one_sided); the joint secondary is outside the family and decides nothing.
noninferiority: a rule that passes must also not be significantly worse on cash: mean(cash_s) + 2 SE >= 0.
real_results: where the games are final (lock + 48 h), each variant's 20 entries' mean real DraftKings points minus conservative's (Sleeper's box), SE over slates: reported, never decisive.
sample: the eligibility registration's sample exactly (research/data/dfs_eligibility/prereg.json): showdowns the PC records before lock (sd_capture, the lead look; the close look when the lead was missed), locking after this registration, in lock order; DEN @ PIT (157076) excluded -- its one-slate figures (captain floor +1.1 points top 1%, 4.7 SE over worlds) are the hypothesis, never evidence.
read: once: at the 12th slate, or on last_read_utc with whatever was recorded (fewer than n_min: INCONCLUSIVE); research/dfs_house_rules_read.py, which answers NOT READY before either.
decision: a primary that Holm rejects, with D > 0 and cash non-inferior, MAY be lifted in production with the owner's sign-off; anything else keeps the rule. The joint relaxation is never adopted from this read.
power: unknown before the first slates; an inconclusive read is insufficient evidence, never evidence that a rule is harmless or harmful.
primary_snapshot_rule: the primary snapshot is the LEAD look (sd_capture: 6 h to 2 h before lock), named before any slate is read (the owner: "designate which pre-lock snapshot is used for the primary research test in advance. We shouldn't retrospectively choose whichever snapshot produced better results"); it must have replayed exact. The close look (50 to 15 minutes before lock) and any hand recording are diagnostic only and never enter the primary read; a slate whose lead look is missing, refused or not exact is not in the sample (never replaced by its close look). The read scripts refuse any other label.

amendments.what: named the primary snapshot (primary_snapshot: lead) and made the read refuse any other; the primary snapshot is the LEAD look (sd_capture: 6 h to 2 h before lock), named before any slate is read (the owner: "designate which pre-lock snapshot is used for the primary research test in advance. We shouldn't retrospectively choose whichever snapshot produced better results"); it must have replayed exact. The close look (50 to 15 minutes before lock) and any hand recording are diagnostic only and never enter the primary read; a slate whose lead look is missing, refused or not exact is not in the sample (never replaced by its close look). The read scripts refuse any other label.
sd_capture.py: its numpy imports guarded by try/except ImportError (the suite's import rule); no behaviour change on the PC
